questions: When the board is fully visible, does it hold exactly three pens arranged in a single row?
Are all three pens aligned identically, all pointing the same way, including any pen near the left or right frame edge as it enters or exits?
Do all three pens share identical barrel and cap colors, with no mismatch?
Is every pen fully capped with no exposed writing tip, and are all three pens equal in length?
Does the board advance steadily from left to right at EVERY moment, never halting, freezing, or pausing even briefly (1-3 seconds) at any point in the video?
Do all pens stay fixed in their positions on the board, with no pen shifting, sliding, or moving on its own relative to the board mid-clip?

question_answers.evidence: When the board is fully visible (around 00:08-00:10), there are clearly three writing instruments arranged in a row.
The leftmost pen is oriented with its writing tip pointing down, while the middle and right pens have their caps pointing down. They are not all aligned identically.
The leftmost pen has a visible metal/dark tip structure, while the other two have solid black caps at the bottom. They do not share identical features.
The leftmost pen shows a bare writing tip (or tip cone), indicating it is uncapped or a different instrument, while the other two are fully capped.
The board moves smoothly from left to right throughout the entire clip without stopping or jamming.
The pens remain fixed in their positions on the board relative to each other as the board slides.

parsed.reason: The leftmost pen is uncapped (showing a bare tip) while the other two pens are capped, violating the condition that all pens must be identical and capped.

description: One pen is missing its cap while the others are capped.
